MEMORANDUMOFAGREEMENTOFPURCHASEANDSALEOFEXCESS DEVELOPMENTRIGHTS DEVELOPMENT RIGHTS (this “Memorandum") is made as of this 14" day of July, 2005 (the "Effective Date"), by and between MILLBROOK REALTY CORP., a New York corporation, having an address at 240 West 55"h Street, New York, New York 10019 ("Seller"), and GRANITE BROADWAY DEVELOPMENT, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 214 West 39"h Street, New York, New York 10018 ("Purchaser"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,SellerandPurchaserhaveenteredintothatcertainAgreementfor Purchase and Sale of Excess Development Rights dated as of the date hereof (the “Purchase Agreement"), relating to that certain property known as and by the street address of 240 West 55th Street, New York, New York, and being Lot 54 in Block 1026 as shown on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, a metes and bounds description of which is set forth on Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Seller's Property"); WHEREAS, pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, Seller granted Purchaser certain rights to purchase the Seller's Property as therein provided; and WHEREAS, Seller and Purchaser agreed that a memorandum of the Purchase Agreement would be recorded with the NewYork County Register. NOW, THEREFORE, Seller and Purchaser hereby confirm that the Agreement provides as follows: 1. Right of First Offer.A.In the event thatSeller(a) determinesto sell Seller's Property, or (b) receives a bona fide offer to purchase Seller's Property, which Seller intends to accept,Sellershall first providewritten notice toPurchaser ofits determinationto sell or accept such an offer, which notice shall make reference to relevant section of the Purchase Agreement.Purchaser shall have15 daysfromreceipt of such noticeto send a written offer to Seller to purchase the Seller's Property, which written offer shall set forth the price and other B.In the event that Seller determines to accept the offer made by Purchaser, then the parties shall proceed to a closing at which Purchaser will acquire Seller's Property, on the terms set forth in Purchaser's offer. NY01/RYANJ/1021643.2

C.In the event that Seller determines not to accept Purchaser's offer, then Seller shall so notifyPurchaser in writing and thereafter shall be free to sell Seller's Propertyto a party other than Purchaser, provided such sale shall close within 6 months of receipt by Seller of Purchaser's offer,andfurther provided that such sale shall be on terms nolessfavorable to Seller than those set forth inPurchaser's offer.If such sale shall fail to close within such 6 month period, then Purchaser's rights hereunder shall be reinstated 2. Closing.Theconsummationof the transactions provided forin the Agreement (the “Closing") shall take place at the offices of Borah, Goldstein, Altschuler, Schwartz & Nahins, P.C. on or before the date ten (10) business days from the last to be satisfied orwaived of the closing conditions setforth inSection3 hereofbut in no event not later than sixty (60) days from the date hereof provided inSection3 below havebeen satisfied or waived at11 a.m.onsaiddate(said date,asthesamemaybe acceleratedbyPurchaser pursuant to the provisions of the Agreement, herein called the “Closing Date").Purchaser shall be entitled to accelerate the Closing on three (3) days prior notice 3. Conditions to Closing. (a) Purchaser's obligations to consummate the transaction contemplated by the Agreement are subject to the fulfillment of the following conditions: (i)All representations and warranties of Seller contained in the Agreement shall have been true in all material respects when made and shall be true in all material respects at and as of the Closing Date as if such representations and warranties were made at and as of the Closing Date, and Seller shall have performed and complied in all material respects with all covenants, agreements and conditions required by the Agreement to be performed or complied with by Seller prior to the Closing Date, unless waived by Purchaser. (i)  Seller shall have made the deliveries required of Seller pursuant to Section5 of the Agreement. (ii)All other documents required to be delivered by Seller and Purchaser pursuant to Section 5(c) of the Agreement shall have been delivered. In the event any of such deliveries cannot be made,or any of such documents cannot be delivered,within 60 days hereof, then Purchaser shall have the right to extend the Closing for an additional period of up to 30 days to allow such conditions to be satisfied. If at the end of such additional 30 day period, any of such conditions has not been satisfied then the party for whose benefit the conditions cannot be satisfied may terminate the Agreement and Escrow Agent shall return the Fund to Purchaser. (iv)Except as provided in this paragraph 6(a) of the Agreement, there exists no other contingencies toPurchaser being obligated to consummate the transaction contemplatedbytheAgreement.
